sources.location: PMC8961214 (Furtwangler et al. 2022, Mol Cell Proteomics 21(4):100219, doi:10.1016/j.mcpro.2022.100219)

https://github.com/bfurtwa/RETICLE (cited in the paper Data Availability; data/<method>/{file_sample_mapping,plate_layout_mapping,sample_layout,sort_layout,balanced_channels_N}.txt, data/diluted_sample/*/mapping.csv, code/diluted_sample.ipynb)

claims.value: 58 June-2021 scMS RAW files (MS2/RTS-MS3/RETICLE x 500/750 ms); one source per TMTpro channel per run (14 cells + carrier)
claims.evidence: Each RAW file is claimed once; file -> (plate, sample) from file_sample_mapping.txt of each method folder.

claims.location: comment[label]; characteristics[cell population]; characteristics[enrichment marker]; factor value[cell population]
claims.value: TMT126 = carrier; 127N..134N (127C empty) = cells; population per channel
claims.evidence: balanced_channels_N.txt gives channel per well, sample_layout.txt gives wells per injection, sort_layout.txt gives CD34-/CD34+CD38-/CD34+CD38+ per well; names LSC/PROG/BLAST from paper Introduction. Paper: 14 single cells + 200-cell carrier per sample, carrier labelled TMTpro-126; sceptre notebook lists the 14 single-cell channels (no 126, no 127C).
OCI-AML8227 AML culture model; PRIDE disease acute leukemia.

claims.location: characteristics[single cell isolation protocol]; comment[facs nozzle size]; comment[facs sorting mode]
claims.evidence: FACSAria III, 100 um nozzle, single-cell sort into 384-well plates; carrier 500 cells in four-way purity mode.

claims.location: comment[modification parameters]; comment[precursor mass tolerance]; comment[fragment mass tolerance]
claims.value: TMTpro K and any N-term fixed; Oxidation M, Acetyl and Met-loss protein N-term variable; 10 ppm; 0.02 Da (MS2, RETICLE) or 0.6 Da (RTS-MS3)
claims.evidence: PRIDE Data Processing Protocol and paper Mass Spectrometry Raw Data Analysis; carbamidomethyl not set for scMS samples (no TCEP/CAA). Not re-read from the .msf/.pdResult files (large).

claims.value: HCD; 32% NCE (MS2, RETICLE) or 45% NCE (RTS-MS3 MS3 scan)
claims.evidence: Paper MS acquisition methods: quant MS2 HCD NCE 32; SPS-MS3 HCD NCE 45. CID 30% LIT scans for RTS are not captured.

claims.value: MS2 / RTS-MS3 / RETICLE at 500 or 750 ms max injection time
claims.evidence: Parsed from file names and the per-method folders of the repository.

limitations: Cell-level source names (method_plate_well) assume each method used its own plates; facs_data files are identical across method folders, so reuse of the same physical cells cannot be excluded from the repository alone, but one lysate can only be injected once.

characteristics[cell type] left not available: LSC/PROG/BLAST are author-defined sorted gates with no exact CL term; the population is carried by cell population, enrichment marker and the factor value.
organism part, age, sex, individual, ancestry are not available (patient-derived OCI-AML8227 culture; no donor data in the deposit).
Search parameters taken from the PRIDE protocol text and paper, not from the 1-2 GB .msf/.pdResult files.

Carrier is one pooled 500-cell plate source; technical replicate is its injection index (1..58) to keep rows unique. The RETICLE_750 file marked faulty is annotated like the others (it is listed in the repository's file mapping).
Dissociation: only the quantification scan (HCD) is recorded; the CID 30% LIT scans used for RTS identification are not.
